resources.string: What is left to do, checked off as it is done: shopping, tasks, a checklist
Checks an item now. In a list set to remove what is checked (remove_when_checked), deletes it instead
Unchecks an item: when it was checked is forgotten

Place in the list, 0 at the top, among every item, checked or not. A position already taken puts the item there and moves the following ones down; without a position the item goes last. Positions stay 0, 1, 2… with no gap
When the item was checked; absent while it is not. Written by the check and uncheck operations, never sent

The moment before which the item is to be done, in a list with due dates (due_dates); optional. At that moment one notification goes out, and the item waits as long as it is not checked. Sent as null to remove the due date
The due date whose notification went out, written by the app; cleared when the due date changes. Never sent
A checked item is removed at once

Whether checking an item deletes it at once, for a list whose done items have nothing left to say (shopping). In such a list, the check operation deletes the item. Turning it on deletes the items already checked, once the change is confirmed (confirm_migration)
Whether items may carry a due date (due_at), notified when it comes; a late item waits to be checked. For something to do once before a moment; a fixed rhythm belongs to the Messages tool
Whether the tile gives each item a single line, showing twice as many (short items: a shopping list); otherwise an item may take two lines. The tool\'s screen is the same either way
